verified_properties: The template fails closed on unbound support admission/launch lengths, hashes, and invocation before checking the output directory or querying systemd/GPU state.
Read-only systemd/cgroup capture is bounded; parent population and memory-event state is captured, and an unavailable own cgroup remains null without host-root fallback.
The exact native run/unit/invocation identity is pinned; output verification metadata is captured only after active/exited/MainPID=0/ExecMainCode=1/ExecMainStatus=0.
The fixed selected GPU UUID is queried as exactly one device row. Compute process rows are capped at 64 and 65,536 stdout characters; malformed/unknown PID, UID, or cgroup identity fails closed.
The GPU observation is read-only: it neither requires an empty device nor reserves VRAM nor changes GPU state; foreign process identities are recorded for observation.
Capture files are O_NOFOLLOW bounded regular-file reads, each capped at 1 MB and the aggregate at 4 MB; all six private code files are rechecked against exact size/SHA pins.
The capture does not invoke a verifier, training or evaluation entrypoint, stop a unit, or read/hash model, training-state, dictionary, cache-array, data, source-tree, or trainer payloads.

review_limits: This is a conditional reader source review only. It does not bind future support receipt bytes or invocation, approve a rendered body, authorize remote querying, or establish a verifier result.
A later exact bound reader must be reviewed separately after root supplies the actual CPU support admission and launch receipts.
